entities.summary: Nikolay Sergeyevich Enikolopov (Enikolopyan) was an Armenian-Russian scientist, Doctor of Chemistry, professor, academic of Russian Academy of Sciences, director of the Institute of Synthetic polymers of the Russian Academy of Sciences. In 1980 he was awarded by the Lenin Prize.
